title: Aquarium plant
description: One aquarium plant species or cultivar. Metric units only. Use null when a value is not known with certainty; never a guess.

$schema.description: Points editors to this schema for autocompletion. Always ../../schema/plant.schema.json.

id.description: Scientific name in kebab-case, without accents. Also the file name: plants/<genus>/<id>.json.

scientific_name.description: Scientific name, with the variety or cultivar when it matters, e.g. "Anubias barteri var. nana".

zones.description: Where it is usually placed in the tank. null if unknown.

growth_form.description: How it grows: stem plants, rosettes from a crown, rhizome plants tied to wood or rock, carpeting plants, grass-like and ribbon-leaved plants, mosses or floating plants.

leaf_color.description: Main leaf color under good conditions; red covers pink, orange and bronze (optional).

max_height_cm.description: Typical maximum height in the aquarium, in centimeters (optional).

light.description: Light it needs to grow well.

growth_rate.description: How fast it grows under suitable conditions.

notes.description: Short original text, in English. Never copied.

sources.description: Where the data comes from. At least one is required for status reviewed.

status.description: draft = not reviewed. reviewed = verified by a human, with sources. Only a human sets reviewed.

nullableRange.description: A { min, max } range, or null when unknown.
